Recorded claim:
The import test commits readable import.sql with one contact, one list, and list membership. create_sqlite.py executes that SQL to produce import.sqlite during the build, moz.build declares the generated output, and browser.ini names it in support-files and generated-files. The generated binary is not the source of truth. When changing the fixture schema or data, update the SQL and generation declarations together so local and CI tests use the same database.
